review_units.title: Evaluator, advice equivalence, and the open target
questions: Does the charged deterministic multitape model admit the exact efficient simulation needed for both T01 directions, without free description access?
Is one description/advice string used for all queries of a fixed length, and are headers, malformed inputs, constants, and the finite exceptional lengths handled?
Does C01 retain every fixed pair of polynomial exponents and infinitely many failing lengths, rather than eventual failure? Is the absent converse from P != NP explicit?
Does P01 use only decidability, without accidentally promising efficient decoding? Are the W02 indexed KT, sequential L, and full-output measures distinguished under their actual overheads?

review_units.title: Counting and self-reduction limitations
questions: Does the description count include lengths zero through s, with each time-valid description determining at most one total answer table, without turning a random-table argument into an explicit SAT bound?

Does the recurrence induction use the correct variable-free boundary and decreasing variable count? Are differing formula lengths and shared circuit subcomputations kept out of the uniqueness conclusion?

review_units.title: Layered residual widths and the limited L02/P03 Lean correspondence
questions: Does L02 measure reachable states at every cut of a deterministic fixed-order, read-once, layered diagram, including initial and terminal layers?
Does the canonical diagram attain all cuts simultaneously? Do SupportedAt and valid-suffix lemmas faithfully match finite Boolean tables, including constant functions and n = 0?
Is the correspondence from a possibly infinite formal carrier to finite reachable layers adequate? Are the compiler pin, allowed logical axioms, and axiom-audit limitations disclosed?
Are grouped width 2^m and interleaved width at most three claims confined to the same incidence encoding, rather than arbitrary SAT encodings or general circuits?
Does the formal grouped predicate match the actual disjointness incidence semantics on valid 2m-bit words, rather than only an artificial selector predicate?
Does P03 establish exactly 2^m distinct midpoint residuals for every natural m, including m = 0, with a lower bound for every correct diagram and a single canonical attaining diagram?

Do the adversarial axiom-audit tests distinguish allowlisted logical axioms from custom or namespaced lookalikes, including opaque-hidden dependencies and sorryAx? Do L02/P03 results leave P04 and the remaining claims unformalized?

review_units.title: Induced matching and all-order grid arguments
questions: Does the induced matching live in the whole graph, excluding same-side as well as cross-side endpoint edges? Does each greedy selection delete at most 2 Delta^2 crossing edges?
For every half-size read set in an even r-by-r grid, does the mixed-row argument yield at least r/2 crossing edges, including r = 2? Does this give the stated exponent r/64?

Are selector length m = r^2, conventional formula length n, and full-table length N = 2^n kept separate? Is the linear general-circuit upper bound preserved, with no width-preserving encoding transfer claimed?
Does the certificate checker validate distinct oriented crossing endpoints and inducedness in the whole graph, including both same-side endpoint edge sets?

Are the certified 2^q distinct prefix residuals and distinguishing suffix witnesses confined to the supplied graph and cut? Does a true packing inequality remain distinct from an actual coverage certificate, including Delta = 0?
Is the finite certificate cap of 256 vertices distinguished from the ten-selector exact signature cap, and from the unbounded manuscript theorem?

review_units.title: Exact graph residual signatures in the fixed selector representation
questions: Do independent read prefixes produce exactly their unread-neighborhood unions, and does the empty unread assignment separate every live residual from the single dead residual?
For two different live signatures, does a singleton suffix separate them, with looplessness retained explicitly? Does a dead residual exist exactly when the read-induced graph contains an edge?

Are the empty cut, full cut, edgeless graph and zero-vertex graph handled? Does the implementation distinguish live mask zero from None, reject invalid graphs, and avoid duplicate-neighborhood overcounting?

Does the separate truth-table oracle validate all reported finite cases and optimal orders without substituting for the proof? Are O(3^m) subset visits, integer bit costs and the ten-selector cap stated without a polynomial-time SAT or general-circuit claim?

review_units.title: Exact finite experiments, not asymptotic proofs
questions: Do the declared domains remain 1 <= m <= 7 for E01 and the five named graphs with at most nine selectors for E02, with boundary layers counted?
Does subset dynamic programming optimize maximum residual width over all orders, and do independent SAT/permutation oracles check implementation behavior rather than certify asymptotic theorems?

Does the minimax helper validate only table shape and positive counts, leaving correctness of externally supplied widths to the caller? Are exact signature counts kept distinct from induced-matching lower bounds?

review_units.title: Conditional literature and missing transfer
questions: Does R01 retain the checked-SAT-solver restriction of Chapman-Williams Theorem 1.1, rather than describe arbitrary separating properties?
Against the specified Oliveira-Pich-Santhanam Theorem 1.4, does R02 preserve both promise thresholds, universal c, existence of epsilon, every sufficiently small constant beta, and input length N?
What concrete reduction, source/target promises and resource transformations would connect a proved source result to R02? None is currently supplied; do not treat the grid bound as that missing step.
Does R03 retain the exact NP-hardness hypothesis and chain-rule convention from the cited revision, without identifying its full-output measure with local access?
Which primary sources and versions were actually inspected in this review? Record unverified bibliography or novelty questions explicitly, not as endorsements.

Does the W04 applicability audit preserve the YES <= s1 and strict NO > s2 promises, all parameter quantifiers and the eventual-YES obstruction, without treating a selector-width bound as a Gap-MCSP reduction?
